items.title: National 8-Day Retreat
items.text: We are profoundly grateful for the graces received during our recent CLC Annual 8-Day Retreat. It was a sacred time of silent prayer, deep reflection, and personal encounter with the Lord, guided by the Ignatian Spiritual Exercises.

items.title: Spiritual Exercises Retreat
items.text: Three days of guided contemplative prayer and personal spiritual direction.

items.title: University Students Vocation Day
items.text: Youth circle exploring life choices, professional ethics, and Christian leadership.

items.title: Feast of St. Ignatius of Loyola
items.text: Today, our Christian Life Community (CLC) family joins the global Church in celebrating the Feast of St. Ignatius of Loyola, the founder of the Jesuits and the source of the Ignatian spirituality that shapes our way of life.

items.title: Gather in Faith, Grow in Love with CLC Family Gathering
items.text: We are filled with gratitude as we look back on our recent CLC Family Gathering! It was a beautiful day of fellowship, prayer, and shared laughter as members from all generations came together to strengthen our bonds.

items.title: Small Group Faith Sharing
items.text: Bi-weekly meeting for Gospel contemplation and Ignatian consciousness review.
